snippet.title: Solar Expanse Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Add Solar Expanse to your wishlist!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1369700/Solar_Expanse/

About the game:
Explore the Solar System. Mine and drop asteroids. Colonize and terraform. Lead the space race and compete with other corporations on your way to profit. Watch the expansion of human race over the centuries. Then go beyond and conquer the galaxy!
